scientific_role: single-use independent-provider nuclear-localization subset confirmation after the Allen schema refusal and imaging-OOD-v2 development pass
scope: nuclear_interior versus nuclear_envelope only; no nine-class or general cell-state authority

official_source.license_constraint: validation-only research use; do not redistribute source pixels; retain attribution and noncommercial/share-alike limitations in derived reporting

metadata_gate.normalized_header: Unicode casefold; remove every non-alphanumeric character
metadata_gate.unmapped_or_missing_phenotype: exclude from supervised confirmation and report

channel_and_image_gate.required_image_linkage: a unique IDR image or original-file pair resolvable from plate, well, field and channel metadata

single_use_sampling.inference_unit: ORF/gene; fields and cells are nested technical observations
single_use_sampling.ORF_selection: ascending sha256(selection_salt|'ORF'|ORF_identifier) independently within nuclear_interior and nuclear_envelope
single_use_sampling.development_gene_overlap: report exact gene-symbol overlap with HPA and OpenCell; retain in secondary all-ORF analysis
single_use_sampling.primary_unseen_gene_analysis: use ORFs whose exact gene symbol is absent from both HPA and OpenCell when at least 20 selected ORFs exist in each class; otherwise refuse unseen-gene authority and use all-ORF result as provider transfer only

image_contract.2D_processing: p1-p99 per-channel clip, center-crop square, BOX resize, uint8 encoding exactly as frozen multiprovider preprocessing
image_contract.if_source_is_3D: maximum project independently per admitted channel before 2D processing

confirmation_endpoints.field_logits_aggregation: mean logits per ORF before temperature and sigmoid
confirmation_endpoints.external_corruption_suite: apply the already-frozen seven imaging-OOD-v2 corruption families to each selected external field without fitting
confirmation_endpoints.confidence_interval: ORF bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples seeded from selection_salt; descriptive because one source laboratory

authority_contract.successful_scope: independent-provider two-channel nuclear-interior versus nuclear-envelope localization and imaging-contract refusal only
authority_contract.future_Aleph_role: nuclear localization observation context only after a matched observation operator; never a direct parameter value

failure_policy.metadata_or_channel_gate_failure: record structural refusal with zero pixels and permit a separately preregistered replacement source
failure_policy.confirmation_endpoint_failure_after_pixe: consume the source, freeze every endpoint result, grant no external localization or OOD authority, and never tune on IDR0006
failure_policy.confirmation_success: promote only the declared nuclear-subset provider-transfer and imaging-refusal scope; retain every Aleph authority block
